# AdMandala

> AdMandala is a programmatic advertising exchange that connects publishers and demand-side platforms (DSPs) through a centralized, quality-focused system — while building the foundation for decentralized, verifiable ad infrastructure. It offers publisher monetization, advertiser supply access, traffic quality enforcement, and a transparent roadmap toward on-chain verification and settlement.

AdMandala is headquartered in India and operates as a live programmatic exchange serving real-time bidding (RTB) traffic. The platform is designed for independent publishers, media networks, SSPs, DSPs, trading desks, performance advertisers, and media buyers.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://admandala.com/): Overview of AdMandala — a programmatic advertising exchange built for performance today and decentralized transparency tomorrow.
- [For Publishers](https://admandala.com/publishers): How publishers can monetize their website traffic through programmatic demand access, IVT filtering, brand-safe environments, and transparent reporting.
- [For Advertisers & DSPs](https://admandala.com/advertisers): How DSPs, trading desks, and advertisers can access curated, quality-controlled publisher inventory via standard RTB workflows.
- [Decentralization Roadmap](https://admandala.com/decentralization): AdMandala's architectural evolution from centralized exchange to a verifiable advertising protocol with on-chain settlement and transparent ad delivery.

## Programs

- [Early Adopter Program](https://admandala.com/early-adopters): A limited program for select publishers to join AdMandala early, shape the marketplace, and receive priority onboarding support.
- [Referral Program](https://admandala.com/referral-program): Invite publishers to AdMandala and earn recurring revenue share rewards ($2 on approval, $3 after 7 days of active traffic, plus 2-5% recurring revenue share for up to 1 year).

## Key Features

- **Programmatic Demand Access**: Connect to quality DSPs and advertisers seeking premium inventory via competitive real-time bidding.
- **Traffic Quality Enforcement**: Built-in IVT (Invalid Traffic) filtering protects publisher reputation and maintains advertiser trust.
- **Brand Safety**: Contextual suitability scoring ensures inventory meets advertiser standards.
- **Transparent Reporting**: Clear performance visibility with standard programmatic workflows and reliable payouts.
- **Decentralization Roadmap**: Progressive evolution from centralized operations to verifiable, on-chain ad event logging and settlement.
- **Simple Integration**: Compatible with existing SSP setups, standard ad serving flows, and minimal technical overhead.
